quote: “Petroleum Agreement” includes any or all of the following documents and or arrangements including, production sharing contracts, joint operating agreements, joint venture agreements, farm-in-agreements or any other document
paraphrase: A farm-in agreement is one of the petroleum agreements the Regulations name.

quote: A Farm Out involves the disposal of a licence interest by the owner - the Farmer Out in return for consideration given by the Farmer In.
paraphrase: A farm out is the disposal of a licence interest by its owner for consideration given by the incoming party.

quote: For relatively unexplored acreage consideration will generally consist wholly, or mainly, of the Farmer in undertaking to bear future costs (e.g. drilling).
paraphrase: On unexplored acreage the consideration is mainly the incoming party paying future costs such as drilling.

quote: The assignment is normally made, subject to government consent, before the work is undertaken and is called a Farm in.
paraphrase: In a farm in the interest is assigned before the work is done.

quote: In contrast, an agreement under which the work obligation is to be completed before the assignment is generally referred to as an earn-in.
paraphrase: In an earn-in the work is completed before the assignment.

quote: The Farmer in may also pay a cash reimbursement to the farmer out for sunk costs relating to the proportionate interest acquired,
paraphrase: The incoming party may also reimburse sunk costs in cash for the share it acquires.

quote: The Farmer in may therefore agree to “carry” the Farmer out by meeting the subsequent development costs relating to the farmer out’s retained interest.
paraphrase: In a development carry the incoming party pays the development costs of the retained interest.

quote: Those costs, probably with an interest element, will normally be recovered from the proceeds of the proportion of the production accruing to the Farmer out’s retained interest.
paraphrase: Those costs are usually recovered, with an interest element, from the production of the retained interest.

quote: The consideration for the disposal of an interest in a producing field is generally in the form of cash or shares.
paraphrase: An interest in a producing field is usually sold for cash or shares.

quote: The phrase “obligation to undertake” is intended to cover all cases where the farmer in commits himself to bear his and the farmer out’s share of the costs of exploration or appraisal work
paraphrase: A work programme obligation covers the incoming party paying its own share and the outgoing party's share of the work.

quote: The reimbursement should therefore be treated as cash consideration for the licence interest acquired.
paraphrase: A reimbursement of earlier costs is cash consideration for the interest.

quote: The value of the right will need to reflect the degree of probability that future benefits will accrue as well as their extent
paraphrase: A right to future benefits is valued by their chance as well as their size.

quote: The increasing interest party (farmer-in or farmee) undertaking a work programme at his own expense,
paraphrase: The same manual calls the incoming party the increasing interest party, the farmer-in or the farmee.

quote: the increasing interest party may also stipulate in the agreement that he recover his costs, usually including an addition representing simple interest, out of production relating to the reducing interest party’s licence interest.
paraphrase: A development carry is usually recovered with an addition for simple interest out of the carried party's production.

quote: When his costs are recovered this is referred to as payback.
paraphrase: The moment the carry is recovered is called payback.
